description: Zero-drag vacuum shot up a 20 deg incline (level bore, shot frame tilted). Validates the shot-frame gravity decomposition (a_x = -g sin phi along-bore deceleration, a_y = -g cos phi perpendicular) used for inclined fire, against the closed-form.

source.citation: Closed-form inclined-fire kinematics in the shot frame, g = 9.80665 m/s^2, no drag. Incline phi = +20 deg, v0 = 600 m/s along bore. x(t) = v0 t - 0.5 g sin(phi) t^2, perpendicular drop y(t) = -0.5 g cos(phi) t^2. Matches cli_api::TrajectorySolver::gravity_acceleration.

expectations.tolerance_justification: Perpendicular drop at t=1.0 s. Quadratic integrated exactly; residual is parabola interpolation over ~6 m spacing (sub-mm). 5 mm ceiling.
Along-bore position is quadratic in t; interpolation of t vs x over ~6 m spacing is sub-ms. 1 ms guard.
Perpendicular drop at t=2.0 s; same basis as t=1.0 s.
